title: Power BI Report and Dashboard Usage
dataSources: Power BI activity events (`o365:management:activity` with `Workload=PowerBI`), Power BI REST Admin API (`/admin/groups`, `/datasets/refreshes`, `/capacities/refreshables`), on-prem data gateway `Mashup`/`GatewayInfo` logs, Premium capacity metrics.
app: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services / Microsoft 365 (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`) for the Power BI activity log; Power BI REST Admin API and on-prem data gateway logs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=o365:management:activity Workload=PowerBI Activity=ViewReport
| stats count as views, dc(UserId) as unique_users, latest(_time) as last_viewed by ReportName, WorkspaceName
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_viewed)/86400,0)
| sort - views
description: Uses the Power BI activity log to rank reports by usage and identify stale reports nobody opens, informing content rationalisation and capacity savings.
value: Unused reports still consume refresh capacity and clutter workspaces; adoption data lets teams retire dead content and justify capacity investment.
implementation: Ingest the Power BI audit log via the Office 365 Management Activity API; schedule weekly; share stale-report lists with owners.
visualization: Bar chart of top reports, table of stale reports, adoption trend.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities (audit log)

grandmaExplanation: We show which Power BI reports people actually open and which are ignored, so you can tidy up and keep what people rely on.
